lines.1: It was already eleven at night...
lines.2: 「What time do you usually go to bed, Otome?」
lines.3: 「Six hours of sleep is sufficient for me. I generally retire at eleven and rise at five.」
lines.5: 「But now we come to the advantage of moving here. I need not wake until six.」
lines.6: 「Which means I can go to bed at midnight.」
lines.7: 「Very grown-up of me, don't you think?」
lines.8: 「I stay up that late without even trying.」
lines.9: 「On school nights, I go to bed at one and get up at eight.」
lines.11: 「Friends in my year often tell me I go to bed early. I never imagined even someone younger would outdo me.」
lines.13: 「Early-morning training is part of my daily routine.」
lines.14: 「In winter, I run over frost that crunches pleasantly underfoot. The morning air is clear too.」
lines.16: 「Well, I'm going upstairs to my room.」
lines.19: 「Tomorrow is Sunday. I thought I might stay up a little late.」
